name: icu-vitals-transformer
description: MCP clinical forecasting skill for ICU vital signs. Provides deterministic trend extrapolation, SafetyShell-bounded forecasting, and DDS deterioration scoring behind a pure-Python core.

resources.name: Clinical vital-sign clamping bounds
resources.description: Physiological min/max bounds applied by SafetyShell (heart_rate 0-300, systolic 0-300, diastolic 0-200, spo2 0-100, respiratory 0-60, temperature 30-45).

resources.name: LOINC-to-vital-type mapping
resources.description: Maps FHIR LOINC observation codes to internal vital types (8867-4=heart_rate, 8480-6=systolic_bp, 8462-4=diastolic_bp, 2708-6=spo2, 9279-1=respiratory_rate, 8310-5=temperature).

resources.name: DDS risk-tier interpretation
resources.description: Deterministic Deterioration Score tiers: NORMAL(0-5), WARNING(6-10), ALERT(11-14), EMERGENCY(15-20), CRITICAL(>20).

tools.name: ingest_vitals
tools.description: Ingest a batch of FHIR R4 Observation resources for a patient. Auto-resolves or creates the active clinical episode and returns the windowed vitals plus the _meta safety envelope.

observations.description: List of FHIR R4 Observation JSON dicts.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Generate a SafetyShell-bounded, trend-aware forecast for an episode at the requested horizon. Includes uncertainty bounds, stale-data warning, and contributing factors.

tools.name: get_deterioration_index
tools.description: Compute the Deterministic Deterioration Score (DDS), severity tier, and contributing factors for an episode; records the episode state transition.

tools.name: discover_episode
tools.description: Discover the currently-active episode and state for a patient. Prompts with MRTR disambiguation when multiple active episodes exist.
